{{Quote|Sorry I missed your call, Yllen. I've been sick. The doctors said it's an allergic reaction, but they weren't stationed on Taris. It's been years, but I swear I recognize the symptoms. Don't tell Amy anything.|One of Magnus's last communications to his partner|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Yllen''' was the partner of [[Magnus (Galactic War)|Magnus]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] ''[[Stardream]]'', with whom they had a [[Youngling/Legends|child]] named [[Amy (Magnus)|Amy]].<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref> the ''Stardream'' was on a voyage from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], and Magnus&mdash;who had been gifted a stuffed [[Orobird/Legends|orobird]] for Amy&mdash;told Amy to ask Yllen for a cage for the pet. However, a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, the ''Stardream'' was overtaken by an outbreak of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], and Magnus's communications to his partner became increasingly incoherent as he succumbed to the infection.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yllen was mentioned in a Codex entry from the Rakghoul Pandemic World Event,<ref name="Codex" /> which was added to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in Game Update 1.1 in [[2012]].<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.1.0/rise-rakghouls|text=Game Update 1.1: Rise of the Rakghouls Patch Notes}}</ref>
